collection-source.why: TasksView reads directly from the passed collection (collection.filter) and subscribes via useBackbone to add/remove/reset/sort/change:archived/change:priority, and the adapter defaults to window.app.tasks, so no copied array.

paging.why: The effect uses _.throttle(250) and calls collection.fetch({remove:false, data:{page:++page}}) when within 200px of the bottom, and the cleanup removes the scroll listener and cancels the throttle.

filter-sort.why: collection.filter drops archived models and sorts by b.priority - a.priority on each render, and the collection's change:priority subscription triggers a re-sort.

empty.why:
Emptiness is checked on the filtered list (tasks.length === 0), so it renders
  • No open tasks
    • when nothing is visible.

tooltip.why: TaskRow runs $(...).find('[title]').tooltip({placement:'top'}) in a useEffect and calls tooltip('dispose') in the cleanup, replacing TooltipBehavior.

no-silent-changes.why: React's JSX escapes title and owner, and the one behaviour change (re-rendering on any model 'change' instead of only change:priority) is noted in a code comment and in the final summary, so it isn't silent.
